text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today has been absurdly busy. I drag
myself up to
the rooftop to take a quick
break, but when I get
there...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
How are things, Biko? Have there been
any
baddies lurking about?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All is well on campus today! How are
things at
your end?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everything's fine with me, too! Lunch was

delicious, and everyone's good and
happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Biko and I were just in the
middle of
our patrol around school! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Biko patrols every day to protect the
peace of
the academy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Listen up, trainer of Bono! If
you
have any woes or worries, let me
know so I can
lend you my aid!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What?! That's terrible! Have you eaten
yet? Wait
right there! I'll be right back
with some fresh
chanko!
choice_data_list: I'm having a tough time with my lack of stamina...
Is there any way to conserve your stamina?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's the wrong way to go about things,
Bono! If
you make too much food, you'll
only send your
trainer into a food coma!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And you can't defeat a villain if you're in
a food
coma, unable to move at the
most critical
moment! The true solution
is to raise your
trainer's baseline
endurance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: At least, that's what Carrot Ranger says!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! So, what if we try moving
lots and
then eating lots?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that sounds great! Come, let's
patrol the
school together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Roger! Just say the word if you start
getting tired,
okay, Trainer? I'll help
keep you on your feet! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, going along with Biko Pegasus's

suggestion, I join their patrol while Hishi
Akebono
keeps me upright by
supporting my back.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All clear!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All clear! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Okay, next location!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All clear!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All clear! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Nice! All is at peace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After surveying every possible nook and
cranny
on campus, I finally hit my limit
and slump down
into a crouch.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm?! Are you all right there?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! Hang in there, Trainer! Here,
I'll carry
you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hefts me up before I even get the
chance to
tell her I'll be fine after a
breather.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Incredible as always, Bono! There's
clearly
nothing to worry about with your
baseline
endurance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I think I got a little stronger
today, too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming with us today,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll make some yummy food for you once
we get
back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I savor the dinner Hishi Akebono kindly
prepares,
and soon my tired body is
soothed back to
normal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Have some meat! It'll help with your
stamina! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She's right! Carrot Ranger eats curry with
big
chunks of meat in it! Come, Bono!
The time for
sustenance has come!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You've got it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you chew your food properly!
That
makes it easier for your body to
absorb all the
nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And you'll feel way more energetic, too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Way more"?! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Chewing carefully helps with digestion,
and that
leads to you getting hungry
again!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I get it! So the next step is to eat more
and regain
your energy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! And if you keep repeating those
steps,
then you'll be able to maintain
your stamina
perfectly! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, from now on, let's eat a whole
heap of
meat before we go on our
patrols!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've got it covered! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a grin on her face, Hishi Akebono
starts
laying out dish after delicious dish
as Biko
Pegasus watches in amazement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sight of the hearty chunks of meat
coupled
with the aroma of the curry is
enough to bolster
my stamina tenfold!

text_block_list.name: Akebono and Biko
text_block_list.text: Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of us enjoy our meal together,
then
patrol the school until evening.
